blocks.tex:
Fix $n \ge 3$ and a moderate-arc profile $(\kappa, \ell)$ over $\ZMod n$ with all
$\kappa_i > 0$, whose Euclidean development \emph{closes} with total turning
$2\pi$: $\mathrm{closureGap}(\kappa, \ell) = 0$ and
$\mathrm{turningSum}(\kappa, \ell) = 2\pi$. Write $P_k = \mathrm{vertexR2}\,
\kappa\,\ell\,k$ for the developed vertices and $\psi_k = \mathrm{heading}\,
\kappa\,\ell\,k$ for the cumulative headings, so that the edge from $P_k$ to
$P_{k+1}$ is $\ell_k e^{i\psi_k}$ and consecutive headings differ by the turning
angle $\psi_k - \psi_{k-1} = \theta_k \in (0, \pi)$
(\cref{lem:turning_angle_sign,lem:turning_angle_lt_pi}, using $\kappa_i > 0$).

The goal is
\[
  \mathrm{IsSimplePolygon}(\mathrm{polygonR2}\,\kappa\,\ell).
\]
The mechanism is the classical one: because the edge directions $e^{i\psi_k}$
rotate \emph{strictly monotonically} through exactly one full turn, the polygon
bounds a convex region and is therefore simple. Concretely we prove a
\emph{support half-plane} statement — every vertex lies weakly to the left of
each directed edge line, strictly so unless it is one of that edge's two
endpoints — and read off the three clauses of $\mathrm{IsSimplePolygon}$ from it.

blocks.title: formalization notes
blocks.body:
Mathlib has no simple-polygonal-curve theory, so the support-halfplane proof is
  from-scratch (confirmed by the api-alignment consult,
  \texttt{analogies/discrete-convex-simple.md}). Recommended idioms: for
  \cref{lem:nonadjacent_disjoint}, obtain each open half-plane as
  \texttt{Convex} via \texttt{convex\_halfSpace\_gt} and push the segment inside
  with \texttt{Convex.segment\_subset}; the partial-sum unimodality of
  \cref{lem:support_halfplane} is a manual \texttt{Finset.sum} induction (split
  the range at the $\pi$-crossing index $p$, monotone up then monotone down). All
  chords/directions are in $\mathbb{C}$; use $\mathrm{Im}(e^{-i\psi}\,\cdot)$ for
  the left-distance functional.

blocks.label: lem:heading_strict_mono
blocks.title: single-step heading increase
blocks.body:
If $\kappa_i > 0$ for all $i$ and $(\kappa,\ell)$ is moderate-arc, then
  $\psi_j < \psi_{j+1}$ for every $j$, since
  $\psi_{j+1} - \psi_j = \theta_{(j+1 \bmod n)} > 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.heading_lt_succ
lean.code:
lemma heading_lt_succ {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (j : ℕ) :
    heading κ ℓ j < heading κ ℓ (j + 1) := by
  rw [heading_succ']
  have := turningAngle_pos h (hκ ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n))
  linarith

blocks.tex:
By definition $\psi_{j+1} - \psi_j = \mathrm{turningAngle}\,0\,\kappa\,\ell\,
  ((j+1 : \mathbb{N}) : \ZMod n)$, which is positive by
  \cref{lem:turning_angle_sign} applied with $\kappa_{(j+1)} > 0$ on the
  moderate-arc domain.

blocks.label: lem:heading_strict_mono_global
blocks.title: strict monotonicity of headings
blocks.body:
Under the same hypotheses, $\mathrm{heading}\,\kappa\,\ell$ is strictly
  increasing on $\mathbb{N}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.heading_strictMono
lean.code:
lemma heading_strictMono {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) : StrictMono (heading κ ℓ) :=
  strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ (heading_lt_succ h hκ)

blocks.tex:
Iterate \cref{lem:heading_strict_mono}: a sequence with every step strictly
  increasing is strictly monotone.

blocks.label: lem:heading_window
blocks.title: heading window bounds
blocks.body:
Under the hypotheses of \cref{lem:heading_strict_mono} together with
  $\mathrm{turningSum}(\kappa,\ell) = 2\pi$: for all $j$,
  $\psi_{j+n} = \psi_j + 2\pi$, and for $j < k < j+n$ one has the strict window
  bound
  \[
    \psi_j \;<\; \psi_k \;<\; \psi_j + 2\pi .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.heading_sub_lt_two_pi
lean.code:
lemma heading_sub_lt_two_pi [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi)
    {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j < k) (hkn : k < j + n) :
    heading κ ℓ j < heading κ ℓ k ∧ heading κ ℓ k < heading κ ℓ j + 2 * Real.pi := by
  refine ⟨heading_strictMono h hκ hjk, ?_⟩
  have := heading_strictMono h hκ hkn
  rwa [heading_add_n hT] at this

/-! ## The support half-plane -/

blocks.tex:
The period jump $\psi_{j+n} = \psi_j + 2\pi$ is the lemma
  \texttt{heading\_add\_n} (\cref{lem:development_recurrences}, already proven in
  \cref{chap:discrete_defs}, using $\mathrm{turningSum} = 2\pi$). The lower bound
  $\psi_j < \psi_k$ is \cref{lem:heading_strict_mono}; the upper bound
  $\psi_k < \psi_{j+n} = \psi_j + 2\pi$ is the same monotonicity applied to
  $k < j+n$.

For a directed edge with heading $\psi_k$, the signed distance of a point $z$ to
the \emph{left} of the edge line through $P_k$ is
$\mathrm{Im}\!\left(e^{-i\psi_k}(z - P_k)\right)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.im_rot_vertex_sub
lean.code:
lemma im_rot_vertex_sub (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (hkj : k ≤ j) :
    (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ k : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        * (vertexR2 κ ℓ j - vertexR2 κ ℓ k)).im
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j,
          ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) := by
  have hdiff : vertexR2 κ ℓ j - vertexR2 κ ℓ k
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j,
          (ℓ (m : ZMod n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ m : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2, vertexR2, ← Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hkj]
  rw [hdiff, Finset.mul_sum, Complex.im_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  have hexp : Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ k : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        * ((ℓ (m : ZMod n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ m : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      = (ℓ (m : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp (((heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [mul_left_comm, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring_nf
  rw [hexp, Complex.mul_im, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring

blocks.tex:
$P_j - P_k = \sum_{m=k}^{j-1} \ell_m e^{i\psi_m}$ by the development
  recurrence \texttt{vertexR2\_succ} (telescoping $\mathrm{vertexR2}$ over
  $[k, j)$). Multiply by $e^{-i\psi_k}$ and take imaginary parts:
  $\mathrm{Im}\!\left(\ell_m e^{i(\psi_m - \psi_k)}\right)
    = \ell_m \sin(\psi_m - \psi_k)$.

blocks.label: lem:support_halfplane
blocks.title: support half-plane
blocks.body:
Assume all $\kappa_i > 0$, $(\kappa,\ell)$ moderate-arc, $\mathrm{closureGap} =
  0$, $\mathrm{turningSum} = 2\pi$. Fix an edge index $k$ and let
  $S(j) := \mathrm{Im}\!\left(e^{-i\psi_k}(P_j - P_k)\right)$ for
  $k \le j \le k+n$. Then $S(j) \ge 0$ for all such $j$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.support_left_nonneg
lean.code:
lemma support_left_nonneg [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (k : ℕ) {j : ℕ}
    (hkj : k ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ k + n) :
    0 ≤ (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ k : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          * (vertexR2 κ ℓ j - vertexR2 κ ℓ k)).im := by
  rw [im_rot_vertex_sub κ ℓ hkj]
  have hmono := heading_strictMono h hκ
  -- backward representation via closure: ∑_{[k,j)} = −∑_{[j,k+n)}
  have hzero : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k (k + n),
      ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) = 0 := by
    have H := im_rot_vertex_sub κ ℓ (Nat.le_add_right k n)
    rw [vertexR2_add_n hE hT k, sub_self, mul_zero, Complex.zero_im] at H
    exact H.symm
  have hsplit : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j,
        ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k)
      = -∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico j (k + n),
          ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) := by
    have hc := Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive
      (fun m => ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k)) hkj hjn
    rw [hzero] at hc
    linarith
  by_cases hcross : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j, heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k ≤ Real.pi
  · -- forward: every increment is nonnegative
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro m hm
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm
    have hαnn : 0 ≤ heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k :=
      sub_nonneg.2 (hmono.monotone hm.1)
    exact mul_nonneg (h.length_pos _).le
      (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hαnn (hcross m (Finset.mem_Ico.2 hm)))
  · -- backward: past the π-crossing every increment is nonpositive
    push Not at hcross
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀mem, hm₀⟩ := hcross
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm₀mem
    rw [hsplit, neg_nonneg]
    apply Finset.sum_nonpos
    intro m hm
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm
    have hm₀m : m₀ < m := lt_of_lt_of_le hm₀mem.2 hm.1
    have hαgt : Real.pi < heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k := by
      have := hmono hm₀m; linarith
    have hkm : k < m := lt_of_le_of_lt hm₀mem.1 hm₀m
    have hwin := heading_sub_lt_two_pi h hκ hT hkm hm.2
    have : Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) < 0 :=
      sin_neg_of_pi_lt hαgt (by linarith [hwin.2])
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (h.length_pos _).le this.le

blocks.tex:
Put $\alpha_m := \psi_m - \psi_k$ for $k \le m \le k+n$, so by
  \cref{lem:heading_window} the $\alpha_m$ are strictly increasing with
  $\alpha_k = 0$ and $\alpha_{k+n} = 2\pi$, and $\alpha_m \in (0, 2\pi)$ for
  $k < m < k+n$. By \cref{lem:left_distance_formula},
  $S(j) = \sum_{m=k}^{j-1} \ell_m \sin\alpha_m$, a partial sum with increments
  $\ell_m \sin\alpha_m$ (recall $\ell_m > 0$). The increment is
  \emph{positive} when $\alpha_m \in (0, \pi)$ and \emph{negative} when
  $\alpha_m \in (\pi, 2\pi)$. Because $\alpha_m$ crosses $\pi$ exactly once (it
  is strictly increasing from $0$ to $2\pi$), let $p$ be the largest index with
  $\alpha_p < \pi$. Then:
  \begin{itemize}
    \item $S(k) = 0$ and $S(k+1) = \ell_k \sin\alpha_k = \ell_k \sin 0 = 0$.
    \item On $k+1 \le j \le p+1$ every increment $\ell_m \sin\alpha_m$
      ($k+1 \le m \le p$) is strictly positive, so $S$ is strictly increasing
      there; hence $S(j) > 0$ for $k+1 < j \le p+1$, and $S$ attains its maximum
      $S_{\max} = S(p+1) > 0$.
    \item On $p+1 \le j \le k+n$ every increment ($p+1 \le m \le k+n-1$, where
      $\alpha_m > \pi$) is strictly negative, so $S$ is strictly decreasing
      there, down to its endpoint value.
    \item The endpoint value is $S(k+n) = \mathrm{Im}\!\left(e^{-i\psi_k}
      (P_{k+n} - P_k)\right) = 0$ because the development closes,
      $P_{k+n} = P_k$ (\cref{lem:development_periodic}), so $P_{k+n} - P_k = 0$.
  \end{itemize}
  A strictly-increasing-then-strictly-decreasing sequence pinned to $0$ at both
  its interior boundary points ($S(k+1) = 0$ on the left of the ascent,
  $S(k+n) = 0$ at the end of the descent) is strictly positive at every strictly
  interior index. Thus $S(j) > 0$ for $k+1 < j < k+n$, and $S(j) \ge 0$
  throughout.

blocks.label: lem:support_halfplane_strict
blocks.title: strict support half-plane
blocks.body:
In the setting of \cref{lem:support_halfplane}, moreover $S(j) > 0$ whenever
  $k+1 < j < k+n$ (strictly, except at $j \in \{k, k+1, k+n\}$, i.e.\ at $P_k$
  and $P_{k+1}$).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.support_left_pos
lean.code:
lemma support_left_pos [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (k : ℕ) {j : ℕ}
    (hkj : k + 1 < j) (hjn : j < k + n) :
    0 < (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ k : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          * (vertexR2 κ ℓ j - vertexR2 κ ℓ k)).im := by
  rw [im_rot_vertex_sub κ ℓ (by omega : k ≤ j)]
  have hmono := heading_strictMono h hκ
  have hzero : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k (k + n),
      ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) = 0 := by
    have H := im_rot_vertex_sub κ ℓ (Nat.le_add_right k n)
    rw [vertexR2_add_n hE hT k, sub_self, mul_zero, Complex.zero_im] at H
    exact H.symm
  have hsplit : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j,
        ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k)
      = -∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico j (k + n),
          ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k) := by
    have hc := Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive
      (fun m => ℓ (m : ZMod n) * Real.sin (heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k))
      (by omega : k ≤ j) (by omega : j ≤ k + n)
    rw [hzero] at hc
    linarith
  by_cases hcross : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Ico k j, heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k ≤ Real.pi
  · -- forward: the (k+1) increment is strictly positive, the rest nonnegative
    apply Finset.sum_pos'
    · intro m hm
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm
      have hαnn : 0 ≤ heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k :=
        sub_nonneg.2 (hmono.monotone hm.1)
      exact mul_nonneg (h.length_pos _).le
        (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hαnn (hcross m (Finset.mem_Ico.2 hm)))
    · refine ⟨k + 1, Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨Nat.le_add_right k 1, hkj⟩, ?_⟩
      have hstep : heading κ ℓ (k + 1) - heading κ ℓ k
          = turningAngle 0 κ ℓ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
        rw [heading_succ']; ring
      have hpos : 0 < turningAngle 0 κ ℓ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) :=
        turningAngle_pos h (hκ _)
      have hlt : turningAngle 0 κ ℓ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) < Real.pi :=
        lt_of_abs_lt (abs_turningAngle_lt_pi h _)
      rw [hstep]
      exact mul_pos (h.length_pos _)
        (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hpos hlt)
  · -- backward: past the π-crossing every increment is strictly negative
    push Not at hcross
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀mem, hm₀⟩ := hcross
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm₀mem
    rw [hsplit, neg_pos]
    apply Finset.sum_neg
    · intro m hm
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hm
      have hm₀m : m₀ < m := lt_of_lt_of_le hm₀mem.2 hm.1
      have hαgt : Real.pi < heading κ ℓ m - heading κ ℓ k := by
        have := hmono hm₀m; linarith
      have hkm : k < m := lt_of_le_of_lt hm₀mem.1 hm₀m
      have hwin := heading_sub_lt_two_pi h hκ hT hkm hm.2
      exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (h.length_pos _)
        (sin_neg_of_pi_lt hαgt (by linarith [hwin.2]))
    · exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_Ico.2 ⟨le_rfl, hjn⟩⟩

/-! ## Simplicity from support -/

blocks.tex:
The strict branches of the same increasing-then-decreasing argument: on the
  ascent every increment is strictly positive from $j = k+1$ on, and on the
  descent every increment is strictly negative down to the endpoint value $0$,
  so every strictly interior index carries a strictly positive value.

blocks.title: remark
blocks.body:
\Cref{lem:support_halfplane} is stated over the lifted range
  $k \le j \le k+n$; since $P_{j+n} = P_j$ and the statement is invariant under
  shifting $j$ by a full period, it transfers to the cyclic vertices
  $\mathrm{polygonR2}\,\kappa\,\ell : \ZMod n \to \mathbb{C}$: for a fixed cyclic
  edge $k$, every cyclic vertex is weakly left of the edge line, strictly so
  unless it is $P_k$ or $P_{k+1}$.

blocks.label: lem:edges_nondegenerate
blocks.title: nondegenerate edges
blocks.body:
Each edge is nondegenerate: $P_i \ne P_{i+1}$ for every $i \in \ZMod n$, since
  $P_{i+1} - P_i = \ell_i e^{i\psi_i}$ has modulus $\ell_i > 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.polygonR2_edge_ne
lean.code:
lemma polygonR2_edge_ne [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (i : ZMod n) :
    polygonR2 κ ℓ i ≠ polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) := by
  have e1 : polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) = vertexR2 κ ℓ (i.val + 1) := by
    have := polygonR2_add_nat hE hT i 1
    simpa using this
  have hd : vertexR2 κ ℓ (i.val + 1) - vertexR2 κ ℓ i.val
      = (ℓ ((i.val : ℕ) : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ i.val : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2_succ]; ring
  have hne : (ℓ ((i.val : ℕ) : ZMod n) : ℂ)
      * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ i.val : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero _ (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
    exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt (h.length_pos _)
  rw [show polygonR2 κ ℓ i = vertexR2 κ ℓ i.val from rfl, e1]
  intro heq
  apply hne
  rw [← hd, heq, sub_self]

blocks.label: lem:nonadjacent_disjoint
blocks.title: non-adjacent edges are disjoint
blocks.body:
If $i, j \in \ZMod n$ satisfy $i \ne j$, $i+1 \ne j$, $j + 1 \ne i$, then
  \[
    \mathrm{segment}\,\mathbb{R}\,(P_i)(P_{i+1}) \cap
    \mathrm{segment}\,\mathbb{R}\,(P_j)(P_{j+1}) = \varnothing .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.polygonR2_nonadjacent_disjoint
lean.code:
lemma polygonR2_nonadjacent_disjoint [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (i j : ZMod n) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hij1 : i + 1 ≠ j) (hji1 : j + 1 ≠ i) :
    segment ℝ (polygonR2 κ ℓ i) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1))
        ∩ segment ℝ (polygonR2 κ ℓ j) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (j + 1)) = ∅ := by
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  rintro z ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
  obtain ⟨r, r', hr, hr', hrr, hz1eq⟩ := hz1
  obtain ⟨s, s', hs, hs', hss, hz2eq⟩ := hz2
  -- L(z) computed from the near edge: on the edge line, hence 0
  have hLnear : (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (z - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im = 0 := by
    rw [← hz1eq, im_rot_affine _ _ _ _ hrr, sub_self, mul_zero, Complex.zero_im,
      mul_zero, zero_add, im_rot_edge_end_zero hE hT i, mul_zero]
  -- L(z) computed from the far edge: strictly positive
  have hLj : 0 < (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (polygonR2 κ ℓ j - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im :=
    support_pos_cyclic h hκ hE hT i j (Ne.symm hij) (Ne.symm hij1)
  have hLj1 : 0 < (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (j + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im :=
    support_pos_cyclic h hκ hE hT i (j + 1) hji1
      (by intro hcontra; exact hij (by linear_combination -hcontra))
  have hLfar : 0 < (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (z - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im := by
    rw [← hz2eq, im_rot_affine _ _ _ _ hss]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs with hs0 | hspos
    · have hs'1 : s' = 1 := by linarith
      rw [← hs0, zero_mul, zero_add, hs'1, one_mul]; exact hLj1
    · nlinarith [mul_pos hspos hLj, mul_nonneg hs' hLj1.le]
  linarith

blocks.tex:
Fix the directed edge $i$ and its line $L_i = \{z : \mathrm{Im}(e^{-i\psi_i}
  (z - P_i)) = 0\}$. Edge $i$ lies on $L_i$. By \cref{lem:support_halfplane},
  every vertex lies weakly left of $L_i$, and \emph{strictly} left unless it is
  $P_i$ or $P_{i+1}$. Both endpoints $P_j, P_{j+1}$ of the other edge are
  distinct from $P_i$ and $P_{i+1}$ (their indices $j, j+1$ avoid $i, i+1$ by the
  non-adjacency hypotheses), hence both lie strictly left of $L_i$. The segment
  $\mathrm{segment}\,\mathbb{R}\,(P_j)(P_{j+1})$ is the convex hull of two points
  strictly in the open left half-plane $\{\mathrm{Im}(e^{-i\psi_i}(z-P_i)) > 0\}$,
  which is convex, so the whole segment lies strictly left of $L_i$. Edge $i$ is
  contained in $L_i$ (imaginary part $= 0$), so the two segments are disjoint.

blocks.label: lem:consecutive_meet_shared
blocks.title: consecutive edges meet only at the shared vertex

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.polygonR2_consecutive_inter
lean.code:
lemma polygonR2_consecutive_inter [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i) (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0)
    (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (i : ZMod n) :
    segment ℝ (polygonR2 κ ℓ i) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1))
        ∩ segment ℝ (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1)) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1 + 1))
      = {polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1)} := by
  have hLj2 : 0 < (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1 + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im := by
    have e2 : polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1 + 1) = vertexR2 κ ℓ (i.val + 2) := by
      have h2 := polygonR2_add_nat hE hT i 2
      rw [show i + ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i + 1 + 1 from by push_cast; ring] at h2
      exact h2
    rw [e2, show polygonR2 κ ℓ i = vertexR2 κ ℓ i.val from rfl]
    exact support_left_pos h hκ hE hT i.val (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [Set.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem]
  refine ⟨⟨right_mem_segment ℝ _ _, left_mem_segment ℝ _ _⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
  obtain ⟨r, r', hr, hr', hrr, hz1eq⟩ := hz1
  obtain ⟨s, s', hs, hs', hss, hz2eq⟩ := hz2
  have hLnear : (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (z - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im = 0 := by
    rw [← hz1eq, im_rot_affine _ _ _ _ hrr, sub_self, mul_zero, Complex.zero_im,
      mul_zero, zero_add, im_rot_edge_end_zero hE hT i, mul_zero]
  have hLfar : (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      * (z - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im
      = s' * (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1 + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im := by
    rw [← hz2eq, im_rot_affine _ _ _ _ hss, im_rot_edge_end_zero hE hT i, mul_zero,
      zero_add]
  have hs'0 : s' = 0 := by
    have hz : s' * (Complex.exp (((-heading κ ℓ i.val : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1 + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im = 0 := by
      rw [← hLfar, hLnear]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 hz).resolve_right (ne_of_gt hLj2)
  rw [← hz2eq, hs'0, zero_smul, add_zero, show s = 1 from by linarith, one_smul]

blocks.tex:
Both segments contain the shared vertex $P_{i+1}$, giving $\supseteq$. For
  $\subseteq$: translate so $P_{i+1} = 0$. The first segment runs into $0$ along
  direction $-e^{i\psi_i}$, the second leaves $0$ along direction
  $e^{i\psi_{i+1}}$, and $\psi_{i+1} - \psi_i = \theta_{i+1} \in (0, \pi)$ by
  \cref{lem:turning_angle_sign,lem:turning_angle_lt_pi}. A point in both segments
  is a nonnegative multiple of $-e^{i\psi_i}$ and of $e^{i\psi_{i+1}}$
  simultaneously; since these two rays are neither equal nor opposite (their
  angular separation $\pi - \theta_{i+1}$ lies strictly in $(0, \pi)$), the only
  common point is $0 = P_{i+1}$. (Concretely, the left-distance
  $\mathrm{Im}(e^{-i\psi_i} \cdot)$ vanishes on the first ray but is
  $\sin\theta_{i+1} > 0$ times the parameter on the second, forcing that
  parameter to $0$.)

blocks.label: thm:convex_simple
blocks.title: L1: positive turning $\Rightarrow$ simple
blocks.body:
Let $n \ge 3$, $[\mathrm{NeZero}\,n]$, $(\kappa,\ell)$ moderate-arc with
  $\kappa_i > 0$ for all $i$, $\mathrm{closureGap}(\kappa,\ell) = 0$, and
  $\mathrm{turningSum}(\kappa,\ell) = 2\pi$. Then
  $\mathrm{IsSimplePolygon}(\mathrm{polygonR2}\,\kappa\,\ell)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive
lean.code:
theorem isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) :
    IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 κ ℓ) :=
  ⟨fun i => polygonR2_edge_ne h hE hT i,
   fun i => polygonR2_consecutive_inter h hκ hE hT hn i,
   fun i j hij hij1 hji1 => polygonR2_nonadjacent_disjoint h hκ hE hT i j hij hij1 hji1⟩

blocks.tex:
The three conjuncts of $\mathrm{IsSimplePolygon}$
  (\cref{def:simple_polygon}) are exactly
  \cref{lem:edges_nondegenerate} (nondegeneracy),
  \cref{lem:consecutive_meet_shared} (consecutive edges), and
  \cref{lem:nonadjacent_disjoint} (non-adjacent edges).

blocks.label: thm:realizesR2_constant
blocks.title: constant positive profiles are realized
blocks.body:
For $n \ge 3$ and $c > 0$, the constant profile $\kappa \equiv c$ satisfies
  $\mathrm{RealizesR2}\,(\lambda\,\_.\,c)$, witnessed by the regular $n$-gon of
  edge length $\tfrac{2}{c}\sin(\pi/n)$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesR2_const
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_const [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    RealizesR2 (fun _ : ZMod n => c) := by
  obtain ⟨hMA, _, hsum, hclose⟩ := regularGon_closes hn hc
  exact ⟨fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n), hMA, hclose, hsum,
    isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive hn hMA (fun _ => hc) hclose hsum⟩

deps.title: regular polygon closes the constant profile
deps.label: lem:regular_gon_closes

blocks.tex:
\Cref{lem:regular_gon_closes} supplies the witness $\ell \equiv \tfrac{2}{c}
  \sin(\pi/n)$ and discharges three of the four $\mathrm{RealizesR2}$ conjuncts:
  moderate-arc, $\mathrm{closureGap} = 0$, and $\mathrm{turningSum} = 2\pi$
  (each turning angle equals $2\pi/n$, so their sum is $2\pi$). The remaining
  conjunct $\mathrm{IsSimplePolygon}(\mathrm{polygonR2}\,(\lambda\_.c)\,\ell)$ is
  \cref{thm:convex_simple}, whose hypotheses hold: $\kappa \equiv c > 0$ is
  positive, and the closure/turning facts are those just quoted. Thus all four
  conjuncts hold.
